show: AI For Humans: Weekly AI News, Tools & Trends
titel: We Tested Infinite AI Video... And We're Zombies Now

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen: keine Merkmale gefunden, aber eine unveraenderte Wiederholungsprobe beweist nichts

einzeiler: Exploring ultra-fast AI video models, real-time agents, and custom AI music training.
kurzfassung: The hosts discuss the rapid advancements in AI video generation, focusing on the new Minimax H3 Max model and interactive streaming formats. They also test custom training an audio model in the style of the band Tool and explore practical uses for AI agents like Instinct. Additionally, they touch upon leaked visuals from OpenAI's upcoming Astra model and Runway's new interactive design software.
stichpunkte: Minimax H3 Max enables ultra-fast, real-time video generation in just seconds.
Developers are creating interactive streaming channels and games powered by new video models.
Runway's Solaris introduces generative interactive design for websites and user interfaces.
OpenAI's rumored Astra model shows impressive visual capabilities, including SVG graphic generation.
The Instinct messaging agent successfully automates complex tasks like organizing podcast tours.
Custom training a Minimax music model successfully evokes the distinct tonal qualities of the band Tool.

clips.hook: Video generation is now faster than the eye can watch
clips.text: The discussion centers on a video generation system optimized for latency that produces clips faster than standard playback speed, creating the possibility of endless streaming.

clips.hook: Building a custom interactive dating simulator with Claude
clips.text: A non-professional programmer explains how they utilized an AI coding assistant to quickly set up and launch an interactive video project.

clips.hook: Customizing your operating system just by asking
clips.text: The hosts describe an open-source operating system designed around agents where users can simply request custom window management or keyboard shortcuts directly from the system.

clips.hook: Deploying an AI agent to handle a complex podcast tour
clips.text: The speaker details a practical test where a text-based assistant successfully searched for suitable podcasts matching specific rating criteria and organized the results into a Google Sheet.

clips.hook: Hearing the distinct guitar tones of Tool in AI music
clips.text: A demonstration showcases how training a base music model with custom descriptors successfully alters the guitar distortion and bass slap to mimic a specific band's style.

beschreibung:
AI news this week: MiniMax H3 Max on Fal is generating video faster than you can watch it, powering never-ending real-time channels (Fal Live, Levels.io's Infinite Slop, Reactor) and we're already breaking it..
On today's AI For Humans, Kevin Pereira and Gavin Purcell go hands-on with what real-time video actually makes possible. Gavin took an open-source interactive game demo, some Fal credits, and a POV dating sim and turned it into something very weird, and we'll show you what worked, what broke, and what it cost. Plus Runway's new Solaris model generates entire interfaces on the fly, and someone built a chatbot running at 14,000 tokens a second.
Also: Sam Altman is out preaching about OpenAI's new Astra model, which may drop this week, and the leaks are leakin'.
Plus: Gavin handed his personal data to three different AI agents, including hot new startup Instinct, which found him a weird concert and a list of podcast bookings (and we may have a few invite codes to give away). Codex mass-edits a Google Calendar and Kevin finally plays the custom-trained MiniMax Music LoRA you asked for (all three of you). And an AI See What You Did There with The Office in Claudish, famous people falling on each other, and Jenny Krakovsky's feature film finished in 50 days.
THE SLOP-AGGEDON IS UPON US. TURN YOUR AIRPODS UP TO 11.
